name: Handball (Size 3)
summary: 32 spherical synthetic-leather panels, with twelve dark slate pentagons and twenty terracotta hexagons. Recessed seams and a grippy baked pebble normal map.
description: 32 spherical synthetic-leather panels, with twelve dark slate pentagons and twenty terracotta hexagons. Recessed seams and a grippy baked pebble normal map.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python spherical panel geometry and Cycles-baked 3D Voronoi normal map; no external assets, logos or text.

display.origin: Floor contact point under the ball centre; lowest actual vertex at Z=0

accuracy_notes: Uses the common men’s size-3 resin-use circumference; no-resin size-3 regulations differ. No resin coating is simulated. Fine grain is baked normal detail only; it does not alter the silhouette. Panel rims are explicit geometry over a recessed spherical bed. No internal bladder, valve, inflation, mass, bounce or physics. Diameter tolerance of 0.8 mm accounts for finite tessellation and rounded panel edges; the actual lowest vertex is translated to Z=0.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, materials and baked texture; no external models, fonts, images or logos.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
